name: vix_bucket_strategy_v1
mechanism: India VIX is constructed from NIFTY option implied volatilities and reflects institutional hedging demand in real time. In Calm regimes (VIX < 13), NIFTY's tight intraday range means market makers aggressively fade 3-minute Bollinger Band excursions — they are collecting spread in low-vol, and any 10-15 spot point deviation from VWAP is absorbed within 30-60 seconds. In Normal regimes (VIX 13-18), large TWAP algorithms run directional orders lasting minutes; an EMA(9-min) crossing above EMA(21-min) on NIFTY signals a fresh wave of institutional buying that typically sustains for 45-90 seconds. In Elevated regimes (VIX 18-24), delta-hedging by options dealers creates self-reinforcing momentum: dealers short gamma who hedge must buy rising and sell falling NIFTY, extending Supertrend-confirmed directional moves for 60-120 seconds. Crisis regimes (VIX > 24) are excluded.
core_signal_oneliner: Three-regime VIX bucket strategy: BB mean-reversion in Calm, EMA crossover in Normal, Supertrend momentum in Elevated
